title: My work orders
body: Work orders assigned to you will appear here. Signed in with your mobile number? The building's office first confirms that it is really you — ask them, then tap “Check for new work”.

detail.noRequestPhotos: {count, plural, =0 {No photos from the resident} one {# photo from the resident} other {# photos from the resident}}

detail.doorCodesHint: Each time the codes are shown, it is recorded. They work only in the visit window.
detail.doorCodesNone: No door codes for this visit
detail.ratingNone: The resident has not rated this work yet

actions.title: Next step
actions.completeNeedsPhoto: Add at least one photo after the work first

photos.beforeHint: Photograph the problem before you start.
